items.title: Kerala High Court confers Senior Advocate designation on 100-year-old P Balasubramanian Menon with longest law practice
items.summary: Kerala High Court has designated veteran lawyer, P Balasubramanian Menon, who holds the Guinness World record for the longest career as a practising lawyer, as a Senior Advocate , with the development coming ahead of his 100th birthday on October 15. Following an initiative taken by Kerala High Court Chief Justice Soumen Sen , the designation was approved on Friday to coincide with Menon's 100th birthday. This might be the first instance of Kerala High Court designating a lawyer practicing before Moffusil courts as a Senior Advocate. Chief Justice Soumen Sen In 2023, Menon entered the Guinness World Records as the longest serving lawyer in the world after completing 73 years and 60 days and continues to hold that record. In an interview with Bar & Bench following the recognition, Menon had spoken about his long legal journey and continuing commitment to the profession. Menon, who began his legal career in 1950, has been practising law for over 76 years. He started practising at the Madras High Court, where he trained under the Advocate General Kuttikrishnan Menon. items.title: NLSIU alumni condemn police action against protesters, Shadan Farasat’s detention
items.summary: The National Law School of India University (NLSIU) Alumni Association has condemned the police action against peaceful protesters across the country on Saturday, October 10, citing the detention and alleged physical manhandling of senior advocate Shadan Farasat and restrictions on lawyers seeking to provide legal assistance to detained protesters. In a statement issued on Saturday, the alumni association described the police action as “arbitrary, illegal, and unconstitutional” and criticised what it called the denial of protesters’ basic constitutional and legal rights. The association said that more than 10,000 people had reportedly been detained across the country. Shadan, an NLSIU alumnus from the 2006 batch, was detained by Delhi Police while attempting to intervene when police personnel were detaining another protester. Videos circulating on social media showed police personnel lifting him by his arms and legs and carrying him away, with his shirt torn during the incident. He was later released. Senior Advocate Shadan Farasat, one of the youngest to be given senior advocate status in India, and a noted legal scholar, was carried away by Delhi Police today. | @Tamal0401 pic.tw

items.title: CJP Protests: Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka released from detention by executive magistrate
items.summary: A Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) court on Sunday morning ordered the release of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activists Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from police detention. They were produced before SEM today morning. Dipke, Das and Ranka were detained by Delhi Police on October 10 shortly after their flight from Mumbai landed in Delhi. The three were travelling to Delhi to participate in the proposed protest at Jantar Mantar demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Delhi Police had denied permission for the proposed demonstration and tightened security across the national capital to prevent protesters from reaching the site. Police personnel entered the aircraft and took the three leaders into custody before they could leave the plane.

items.title: CJP leaders Dipke, Ranka, Das released by Delhi Executive Magistrate
items.summary: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) conveners Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were released from police custody by the Special Executive Magistrate Court at the Delhi Cantt Police Station on Sunday, October 11. CJP legal affairs head Ratna Singh confirmed to TNM that all three leaders have been released. The release came almost 24 hours after the CJP leaders were taken into custody from inside their flight at the Delhi airport on October 10. YouTuber Dhruv Rathee, who was detained from his house in Gurugram on October 10 morning, was also reportedly released later in the night.
